Reference / http/exchange

http/exchange#

What a client sends and gets back.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let reply = await client.get("https://example.com/");
reply::Head::status;                         // Status.ok
reply::Head::headers.text("Content-Type");
reply::Exchange::history.size();             // redirect hops before it
reply::Exchange::details.secure();           // came over TLS
await reply.text();

Description#

What a client sends and gets back.

Exchanging is the role of anything that sends a request: HttpClient and every decorator around it.

object ClientResponse#

object ClientResponse

What a client got back for a request: the final response, the hops before it and how it travelled. Its head is the cap Head and the exchange around it the cap Exchange. The body is read once: whole with bytes(), text() or json(), or piece by piece through reading().

ClientResponse.text#

async text() is string

The whole body as text, decoded by the charset of its Content-Type: UTF-8 when there is none; US-ASCII and ISO-8859-1 are also read.

ClientResponse.json#

async json() is Json

The whole body parsed as JSON. A UTF-8 body goes to the parser as bytes (#135); a body in another charset is decoded first.
